subject: Demo sync — technical alignments & POC lane
messages:
From: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@healthvera.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-09T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo — quick summary and clarifications

Thanks for the walkthrough this morning. Quick write-up from our side so we’re aligned before we lock a POC lane. High-level goals and pain points we discussed: 

- Primary goal: reduce triage latency and surface more accurate case routing for clinical intake. Target is p50 < 300ms for short queries and consistent rerank quality across our document types.
- Pain: current infra gives variable latency spikes (p95 often > 1.5s), and our current reranker often elevates stale documents.
- Must-haves: streaming token-by-token responses for chat UI, function-calling to safely call out to our EHR adapter (FHIR endpoints), and a structured-output payload for triage categories (we showed samples).
- Nice-to-haves: embedding-based semantic search for archived notes, and an option to fall back to cross-encoder rerank for high-risk triage.

Procurement asked we confirm: committed spend window options, required security evidence (SOC 2 + DPA), and SSO integration timelines. I’ve cc’d procurement for those conversations.

Next steps from HealthVera: please send a short tech blurb on the SDK changes you mentioned and an example structured-output schema so our engineering team can validate. Also propose dates for a 2-week POC lane and what success criteria we should run against.

— Rachel
Rachel Gomez
Head of Clinical Products, HealthVera
rachel.gomez@healthvera.com
(415) 555-0178
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@healthvera.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo — quick summary and clarifications

Thanks Rachel — great to capture this. Below is a compact summary and the commitments we can make now. Attaching a short integration notes PDF and a proposed structured-output schema (JSON) so your eng team can validate mapping.

What we heard (condensed):
- Latency SLO: p50 ~300ms on short queries; p95 target depends on document size but we’ll aim to reduce spikes.
- Streaming: required for a responsive chat UI. We’ll stream tokens and structured chunks (see SDK hook).
- Function calls: safe, auditable function-calling pattern for your EHR adapter + optional parameter validation layer.
- Rerank strategy: embeddings for candidate recall + an optional cross-encoder reconciliation step for top-N safety checks.
- Structured outputs: we’ll provide a schema versioned as v2 and an example mapping to your triage categories.

Committed deliverables (this week):
1) Integration notes PDF (attached) — outlines runtime options (hosted/dedicated/private), data path for function calls, and minimal config for a 2-week POC.
2) structured-output-schema-v2.json (attached) — example mapping the triage fields you demoed.
3) Lightweight SDK preview (node + python snippets) showing: streaming token callbacks, structured-output emitter, and function-call contract.

Proposed POC lane (dates): 2027-05-24 -> 2027-06-07 (2 weeks). Success criteria suggestion: average inference cost < baseline * 0.6, p50 < 300ms on canonical short queries, and >= 15% improvement in top-1 rerank relevance on your eval set. We can refine metrics with your eng team.

Security & procurement notes: we can share SOC 2 Type II artifact and a standard DPA; if you require a customer-managed VPC or on-prem package we’ll flag that as a scope callout (may change lead time).

Next immediate asks for HealthVera engineering: could you share a small sample of 25 anonymized documents (or a synthetic proxy) so we can run a quick embedding/rerank spike test? Also confirm who from procurement will coordinate the contract/workflow.

Attachments: redwood_inference_integration_notes.pdf, structured-output-schema-v2.json

— Irene Choi
Product Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
irene@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@healthvera.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo — quick summary and clarifications

Adding a few engineering specifics so the POC runbook is clear. Quoting Rachel below for context.

On 2027-05-09 15:12, Rachel Gomez wrote:
> Primary goal: reduce triage latency and surface more accurate case routing for clinical intake. Target is p50 < 300ms for short queries and consistent rerank quality across our document types.

POC tech notes / minimal implementation plan:
- Environment: we’ll provision a scoped dedicated pool (small) for the POC to stabilize variance. If you prefer hosted, we can provide a reserved tenancy for the trial window.
- SDK changes: we’ll ship a preview package with the following hooks:
  * stream.on('token', cb) — emits tokens and partial structured chunks
  * stream.on('chunk', cb) — for structured-output objects as soon as they’re produced
  * rerank.run(candidates, embeddingHints) — runs an embed-based candidate recall + optional cross-encoder re-rank step
  * functionCall.invoke(contract, payload) — signs and logs invocations for audit (compatible with your EHR adapter)
- Operational: recommend a 1-hour smoke test day 1, and an automated run of your eval set with A/B toggles (our SDK will support toggling cross-encoder reconciliation off/on).
- Metrics: Redwood telemetry will give token-level latency, cost, and model-route breakdowns. We’ll also push a daily artifact of rerank outputs for your team to review.

Security/procurement: we can provide SOC 2 Type II report and a standard DPA. For SSO we support SAML and OIDC; estimate 2–3 business days of work on your side to accept our SSO metadata.

Action items assigned:
- HealthVera: share the 25-sample dataset (anonymized or synthetic) — Rachel.
- Redwood (Ben): provision POC capacity and hand over SDK preview (ETA 2027-05-17).
- Redwood (Irene): schedule a POC kickoff call 1 week before the start date.

I’ll prepare the POC runbook after the SDK preview lands.

— Ben Carter
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Gomez <rachel.gomez@healthvera.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: HealthVera Procurement <procurement@healthvera.com>
Date: 2027-05-11T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo — quick summary and clarifications

Appreciate the clear next steps. Procurement (cc) — we expect standard DPA and SOC2 materials; please let us know if a custom addendum is needed for our security team.

We’ll provide the 25-sample synthetic set by EOD Thursday. Also confirming the POC window (2027-05-24 to 2027-06-07) — sounds good on our side.

Small note on rerank: for triage we only want cross-encoder reconciliation applied to top-3 candidates; beyond that we prefer embed-only ranking for cost/time reasons. Hope the SDK toggle covers that.

I’ve attached a short decision framework and procurement contact info. Once we have your SDK preview and the structured schema we’ll schedule the engineering validation call (tentatively 2027-05-18).

Attachments: decision_framework.xlsx

Thanks — Rachel
